purpose: Find promising additional cases, without estimating population error prevalence.
author_scope: All external written submissions; no selection by ideology, organisational identity, or Lobbyregister membership alone.
date_scope: Prioritise the 25 July–24 October 2026 collection. Older or differently scoped leads must be labelled separately.
selection_signals: A specific checkable statistic, study conclusion, legal rule, deadline or absolute technical assertion.
The assertion supports an explicit and consequential policy request in the document.
A concrete source-scope, denominator, time-period, baseline, causal-attribution or exact-draft question can be identified.
The necessary original evidence is identifiable, making a decisive check feasible.
preferred_routes: Follow sources underlying already documented major mismatches into distinct unread submissions.
Compare quantified fiscal, compliance-cost or market-share claims with the original tables and denominators.
Compare claims about legal requirements with the exact addressed draft and underlying authoritative instrument.
Compare categorical scientific or technical claims with the methods, population, outcome and conclusions of the cited original evidence.
deprioritisation_rules: Do not treat an uncertain forecast, stated model assumption or policy disagreement as an error.
Do not pursue incidental citation defects solely to increase the finding count.
Read surrounding qualifications before assigning priority.
Retain plausible benign explanations and stop promotion where they cannot be resolved.
Do not reopen already exhausted interpretive leads without new primary evidence.
novelty: Check binary identity and author/version context against the existing reading ledger. A different register record is not automatically a new submission.
independent_review: Each branch's priority candidates receive a different AI agent's plausibility and novelty review. Selection review is not validation of a factual error.
counting: Automated extraction or ranking adds no screened documents. Actual lead-selection passage reads are recorded separately until reconciled into the main reading ledger; no lead is added to the findings numerator.
reporting_limit: A higher finding yield in this deliberately targeted pool would not demonstrate a higher error rate across all legislative submissions.
